record_title: Morse maxima force a t^{-1/4} localization law in the slow cell-polarization limit
provenance: Sharp long-time asymptotics for the D=infinity slow-limit cell-polarization free-boundary system introduced in arXiv:2609.20609v1, under finitely many nondegenerate signal maxima.
limitations: The theorem applies to the D=infinity slow-limit system with a time-independent signal and finitely many isolated nondegenerate maxima. It does not establish the same rate for finite D, degenerate maxima, moving signals, or the original positive-mass parabolic PDE uniformly in mass. Originality is qualified to the best of our knowledge.
